description: Test file for Kubernetes core v1 API conversions and related functions, including PodStatus, PodSpec, ResourceList, and conversion round-trips between internal and v1 representations.

methods.name: TestPodLogOptions
methods.description: Tests encoding and decoding of PodLogOptions between internal and v1 versions, including URL parameter serialization.

methods.name: TestPodSpecConversion
methods.description: Verifies conversion between internal core.PodSpec and v1.PodSpec, especially alias handling for ServiceAccount.

methods.name: TestResourceListConversion
methods.description: Checks conversion of ResourceList with various quantities, including rounding and large values.

methods.name: TestReplicationControllerConversion
methods.description: Ensures round-trip fidelity of conversions between v1.ReplicationController and apps.ReplicaSet.

methods.name: TestReplicaSetConversion
methods.description: Ensures round-trip fidelity of conversions between apps.ReplicaSet and v1.ReplicationController.

methods.name: roundTripRS
methods.description: Encodes and decodes a ReplicaSet object to test serialization integrity.

methods.name: Test_core_PodStatus_to_v1_PodStatus
methods.description: Tests conversion from core.PodStatus to v1.PodStatus, focusing on PodIP and PodIPs fields.

methods.name: Test_v1_PodStatus_to_core_PodStatus
methods.description: Tests conversion from v1.PodStatus to core.PodStatus, including handling of mismatched IPs and multiple IPs.

methods.name: Test_core_NodeSpec_to_v1_NodeSpec
methods.description: Tests conversion from core.NodeSpec to v1.NodeSpec, especially PodCIDRs and PodCIDR fields.

methods.name: Test_v1_NodeSpec_to_core_NodeSpec
methods.description: Tests conversion from v1.NodeSpec to core.NodeSpec, including handling of PodCIDRs and PodCIDR fields.

methods.name: TestConvert_v1_Pod_To_core_Pod
methods.description: Tests conversion from v1.Pod to core.Pod, verifying TerminationGracePeriodSeconds normalization.

methods.name: TestConvert_core_Pod_To_v1_Pod
methods.description: Tests conversion from core.Pod to v1.Pod, verifying TerminationGracePeriodSeconds normalization.
